## Checklist

- [ ] Tests cover the change (a bug fix includes the test that would have caught it)
- [ ] For a security control: mutation-checked (disabled it, a test failed, restored it)
- [ ] Docs updated (options, errors, security, guide pages) and `pnpm docs:check` passes
- [ ] `[Unreleased]` in CHANGELOG.md updated
- [ ] A DECISIONS.md entry, if this makes a design choice or records an interop finding
- [ ] Breaking for users or for SPs? Checked against docs/guide/versioning.md
- [ ] No real keys, certificates or personal data anywhere
